title: Stickers
description: Mod that adds sticky notes to your HUD. You can change them as you want: text, position, color, and rotation.
body:
Mod adds new mechanic to your HUD - Sticky notes.



By pressing the **K** key, you'll get to Stickers Manager menu.
You can add, edit, delete them, and toggle their visibility.



There is also a Drag Mode. Use **G** key to open it.
You can drag the sticky notes in real time!
